clue.text: A plank on a ship

parts.note: a plank is a board of timber

explanation.surface: A gangplank lying on a ship's deck.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on board a vessel means being carried as a passenger or crew on it.

clue.text: Eject upstart interrupting the head

indicators.note: interrupting means one piece breaks into the middle of the other

parts.note: bonce is British slang for the head
read as up-start: the start of 'up' is its first letter

explanation.surface: A bouncer throws out an upstart who barged in on the head of the firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upstart' is split as 'up' + 'start', giving U; BONCE is informal British for the head.
explanation.definitionFit: To bounce someone is to throw them out forcibly, as a nightclub doorman does.

clue.text: Dogs with chains

parts.note: with means and, joining things together
irons are fetters or chains for prisoners

explanation.surface: Dogs kept on chains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dogs' looks like animals but means fire-dogs, the metal stands that hold logs in a hearth.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire-dogs are the pair of metal supports holding logs in an open fireplace.

clue.text: Broadcast from, dance club linked with part of London University

annotationWithheld.why: Broadcast from dance club linked with part of London University (scan confirms): DISCO + LSE gives DISCOLSE, not DISCLOSE; only an anagram of the synonyms with no indicator, or 'Broadcast' as both definition and anagram signal, yields the answer
annotationWithheld.clue: Broadcast from, dance club linked with part of London University

clue.text: Obsolete Jumbos phased out ages ago

definitions.text: Obsolete Jumbos phased out ages ago

parts.words: Obsolete Jumbos phased out ages ago
parts.note: reads like retired jumbo jets, but means extinct elephant-like beasts of the Ice Age

explanation.surface: Old jumbo jets withdrawn from service long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: These woolly prehistoric relatives of the elephant died out thousands of years back.

clue.text: Mother has to press English ornamental work

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
to cram is to press or stuff in

explanation.surface: Mother has to iron a piece of English decorative needlework.
explanation.definitionFit: This is decorative knotted string or cord craft, a kind of fancywork.

clue.text: Mounting hesitation to put down furry animal

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounting means the word for hesitation is read upwards

parts.note: um is a sound of hesitation
to squash someone is to put them down

explanation.surface: Growing reluctance to have a furry pet put to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: It is another name for the muskrat, a North American fur-bearing rodent.

clue.text: Bound, we hear, to get dreadful 'flu, being naive

indicators.note: we hear says the word for bound is taken by its sound

parts.note: bound means tied up, trussed

indicators.note: dreadful says the letters of the word for influenza are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone tied to catching a terrible bout of influenza, too innocent to avoid it.
explanation.walkthrough: TRUSSED sounds like TRUST; 'dreadful' turns FLU into FUL.
explanation.definitionFit: A trusting, credulous person is innocent and believes others too readily.

clue.text: Polar transport, with carriers in attendance

definitions.text: Polar transport, with carriers in attendance

parts.words: Polar transport, with carriers in attendance
parts.note: polar suggests the Arctic, but means a seat carried on poles by two bearers

explanation.surface: An expedition to the Pole with porters along.
explanation.definitionFit: This enclosed seat for one person was borne on two poles by porters in the 18th century.

clue.text: Accused learner admitted crashing in dead end

indicators.note: admitted means one piece is let inside another
crashing suggests the letters of the first word are smashed and rearranged

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: An accused learner driver confessed to crashing in a dead-end street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashing' scrambles ACCUSED into CUDESAC, and L goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A street closed at one end is a blind alley with no way through.

clue.text: One's taken to court and released

parts.note: one is I, and 's is is, giving I + S
to be sued is to be taken to court

explanation.surface: Someone prosecuted and then freed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put out or released has been sent out officially, like a stamp or statement.

clue.text: Impressive article from outstanding literary period

parts.note: august means impressive or venerable
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An impressive essay from a golden age of literature.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Emperor Augustus, the term denotes a classical golden age of writing, in Rome or 18th-century England.

clue.text: Paper admitting vagrant worker's large capacity for drink

indicators.note: admitting means the first word takes the second inside it

parts.note: a ream is a quantity of paper, 500 sheets
a hobo is a wandering itinerant worker in American usage

explanation.surface: A newspaper features a tramp who drinks heavily.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a big wine or champagne bottle holding about six standard bottles.

clue.text: Not beyond correction -go to expert

parts.note: to repair to a place is to go there
able means skilled, expert

explanation.surface: Something fixable, so take it to a specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can still be mended or fixed is not past saving.

clue.text: Do well as exiled duke, having nothing to lose, finally

indicators.note: to lose, finally means a letter goes from the very end of the duke's name

parts.note: Prospero is the banished Duke of Milan in Shakespeare's The Tempest
O is nothing, zero

explanation.surface: An exiled nobleman thrives in the end, having nothing to lose.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrive or flourish is to succeed.

clue.text: Extrovert retiring from office

definitions.meaning: leaving a post, as a departing chairman does

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both sociable and departing, as of an official about to leave.

clue.text: Left on plane with upper-class young woman for place abroad

parts.note: port is the left side of an aircraft or ship
U denotes upper-class in British usage
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A posh girl leaves on a flight to a foreign destination.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a European country, a foreign place from the British viewpoint.

clue.text: Shakespearean character hard to find in work by Lamb

indicators.note: to find in means the letter for hard sits inside the other pieces

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
Elia was the pen-name of the essayist Charles Lamb
H is hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A Shakespearean role is difficult to locate in a book by Lamb.
explanation.walkthrough: Lamb's Tales from Shakespeare makes the surface plausible; here 'Lamb' just points to his pen-name Elia.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's beloved, who drowns, is a figure in one of Shakespeare's plays.

clue.text: Drink is on the table where the score is kept

parts.note: a peg is a measure of spirits
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A drink sits on the table where a game's tally is recorded.
explanation.definitionFit: In cribbage, players mark points by moving pins along a holed scoring board.

clue.text: Snag in elegant new ensemble

indicators.note: ensemble means the letters are put together in a new grouping

explanation.surface: A thread catches on a stylish new outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue words ELEGANT and N are combined and rearranged; 'ensemble' looks like an outfit but signals the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: To snag something is to catch or tangle it.

clue.text: Music heard in church as rector initially enters into it

indicators.note: enters means one letter goes inside the following words
initially means only the first letter of rector is used

explanation.surface: A rector starts to walk into a church as music plays.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a psalm or antiphon sung as the priest approaches the altar at the start of Mass.

clue.text: Near the end of August, discordant sound identifies this bird

parts.note: nigh means near

indicators.note: the end of means the last letter of August is taken

parts.note: a jar is a harsh, grating sound

explanation.surface: In late August a jarring noise reveals a particular bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a nocturnal bird, the goatsucker, known for its churring call.

clue.text: Not inclined to maintain son on drug

parts.note: to aver is to maintain or assert
E is ecstasy, a drug

explanation.surface: Unwilling to keep a son on medication.
explanation.definitionFit: Being opposed or reluctant is being unwilling.

clue.text: Appropriate way to involve one political type

indicators.note: to involve means the letters for one are taken inside the others

parts.note: right means appropriate or proper
St is street, a way
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: The proper way to get a political figure involved.
explanation.definitionFit: A conservative or member of the right wing is a political person of that stamp.

clue.text: Contract, perhaps, that's set up between banks

definitions.meaning: contract is one version of the card game
a span built across a river from one side to the other

explanation.definitionFit: Contract is a form of the card game, and the structure spans a river.

clue.text: Building a mandarin may grow up in

definitions.text: Building a mandarin may grow up in

parts.words: Building a mandarin may grow up in
parts.note: mandarin suggests a Chinese official raised somewhere, but it is a citrus fruit grown in a glasshouse

explanation.surface: The house where a Chinese official was raised.
explanation.definitionFit: A glasshouse for citrus trees is where such fruit is cultivated.

clue.text: For tropical fruit, for example, good to prepare before time

indicators.note: before puts the word for prepare ahead of the letter for time

parts.note: G is good
to plan is to prepare
T is time

explanation.surface: Getting a tropical fruit ready in good time.
explanation.definitionFit: Aubergine is the British name for this purple fruit of a tropical plant.

clue.text: Dredge river dock

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
a pen is a dock for submarines

explanation.surface: Dredging the river by the dockside.
explanation.definitionFit: To dredge a channel is to make it go further down.
